question: Why is even immense material wealth insufficient compared to the value of this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
It serves as a measure of incomparable value
inference: Even wealth enough to fill the ocean with jewels is not comparable to this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear form; parsing is tentative
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels...
